title: August and the Veil
premise: Oscar Reyes, a scribe indentured to the Guild of Impossible Things, is ordered to record the arrival of a child named August who speaks the First Tongue — a language that predates kingdoms and can unmake the Veil separating the mortal world from the war-hungry realm beyond. As Oscar deciphers August's words, they discover the child is not a messenger but a living key, and that the Guild itself engineered the thirteenth moon to force the Veil open. Torn between loyalty to the master who owns their debt and the truth burning in their ledgers, Oscar flees with August, pursued by guild hunters and a former lover now sworn to duty. At the climax, Oscar must choose: erase August from every ledger and let the Veil stand on a lie, or speak the First Tongue aloud themselves and bind the two worlds into an uneasy, honest peace. They choose truth — at the cost of their name in every record, becoming a person no ledger can own.
about_author: Coral Sterling is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing documents no one was meant to read. She writes fantasy about people trapped by paperwork, prophecy, and other people's good intentions.

chapters.title: The Ledger of Small Debts
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. We meet Oscar balancing impossible accounts for the Guild of Impossible Things, counting down the years left on their indenture. Emotional beat: weary resignation masking a hunger for freedom.

chapters.title: A Knock Before Dawn
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. A mud-soaked child appears at the guild door during a storm, speaking words no one can parse — except the ledgers seem to react. Emotional beat: unease sharpening into wonder.

chapters.title: The Master's Interest
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. Master Veyren claims the child immediately, ordering Oscar to transcribe everything August says. Emotional beat: dread; Oscar recognizes possessiveness when they see it.

chapters.title: Words Older Than Walls
chapters.summary: August's POV. The child's first interior chapter reveals fragments of memory from before the Veil, and terror at being studied. Emotional beat: loneliness meeting cautious curiosity toward Oscar.

chapters.title: Ink That Listens
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. Transcribing August's speech, Oscar notices the ink rearranging itself — the language writes meaning, not sound. Emotional beat: scholarly thrill curdling into fear.

chapters.title: The Thirteenth Moon
chapters.summary: Veyren's POV. The master consults a hidden almanac showing a moon cycle that shouldn't exist, revealing his timeline. Emotional beat: cold ambition dressed as stewardship.

chapters.title: Bargains in the Stairwell
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. Oscar bargains with guild quartermaster Sefa for information about the Veil, paying with forged entries. Emotional beat: guilt entwined with growing resolve.

chapters.title: What August Remembers
chapters.summary: August's POV. August recalls a city beyond the Veil and a promise made by someone wearing Oscar's face in a dream. Emotional beat: hope as a dangerous thing.

chapters.title: The Hunter Arrives
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. Guild hunter Ilara Vance returns from the borderlands — Oscar's former lover — assigned to guard August. Emotional beat: old love colliding with new suspicion.

chapters.title: Ledger Fire
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. A page of the transcription spontaneously combusts, and Veyren blames sabotage, tightening security. Emotional beat: paranoia; Oscar realizes someone else knows.

chapters.title: Sefa's Price
chapters.summary: Sefa's POV. Sefa reveals the Guild built the thirteenth moon's mechanism beneath the temple, then demands Oscar help her steal it. Emotional beat: betrayal offered as salvation.

chapters.title: Lessons After Curfew
chapters.summary: Oscar and August's alternating POV. Secret night lessons: August teaches Oscar the First Tongue; Oscar teaches August how to lie. Emotional beat: tenderness blooming in conspiracy.

chapters.title: Ilara's Report
chapters.summary: Ilara's POV. Ilara files a report she knows is incomplete, protecting Oscar out of love she won't name. Emotional beat: duty grinding against devotion.

chapters.title: The Room Beneath
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. Oscar descends into the vault and finds the moon-engine: a vast orrery keyed to August's voice. Emotional beat: vertigo of scale — this has been planned for centuries.

chapters.title: Owned Words
chapters.summary: August's POV. August discovers their name written in the guild's founding charter, dated before their birth. Emotional beat: horror of being a purchased prophecy.

chapters.title: A Debt Called Love
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. Veyren offers to erase Oscar's debt if they deliver August to the engine on the final night. Emotional beat: temptation laid bare — freedom priced at betrayal.

chapters.title: Crossing Purposes
chapters.summary: Oscar and Ilara's POV. Ilara confronts Oscar about the missing pages; almost-confessions, almost-accusations. Emotional beat: love against duty made flesh.

chapters.title: The Cartographer's Map
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. A dying cartographer leaves Oscar a map of the Veil's thin places — and a warning that the last thin place is inside the temple. Emotional beat: urgency compressing time.

chapters.title: Thirteen Turns
chapters.summary: August's POV. August counts the moons remaining and understands they are meant to die opening the door. Emotional beat: quiet, terrible acceptance.

chapters.title: Midnight Requisition
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. Oscar steals the engine's keystone page, forging a perfect duplicate — the finest forgery of their life. Emotional beat: exhilaration shadowed by the point of no return.

chapters.title: Hunted Through the Stacks
chapters.summary: Multiple POV. The forgery is discovered; hunters sweep the archive while Oscar smuggles August through hidden stacks. Emotional beat: breathless flight.

chapters.title: Ilara Catches Them
chapters.summary: Ilara's POV. Ilara corners them at the canal gate — and lets them go, tearing her own commission in half. Emotional beat: sacrifice disguised as desertion.

chapters.title: The Thin Place
chapters.summary: Oscar and August's POV. They reach the Veil's edge and hear the other side singing; August falters, afraid of what waits. Emotional beat: awe braided with grief.

chapters.title: What Waits Beyond
chapters.summary: August's POV. Through a rift, August sees the exiled First Speakers — not monsters, but refugees begging not to be remembered wrong. Emotional beat: myth inverted into mercy.

chapters.title: Veyren's Sermon
chapters.summary: Veyren's POV. The master addresses the guild, framing the coming opening as holy renewal. Emotional beat: charisma as a weapon; the crowd's hungry faith.

chapters.title: Recaptured
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. Guild hunters take them at the border town; August is separated, and Oscar is dragged back in chains. Emotional beat: despair, then a spark — Sefa is among the guards.

chapters.title: The Cell and the Confession
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. In a cell, Oscar finally tells Ilara everything, including their forged first entry that started it all. Emotional beat: shame transformed into trust.

chapters.title: Sefa's True Ledger
chapters.summary: Sefa's POV. Sefa betrays the escape plan to Veyren — but only to get close enough to poison the engine's heart. Emotional beat: loyalty revealed as its own kind of treachery.

chapters.title: The Twelfth Turn
chapters.summary: Oscar and August's POV. Reunited in the vault on the penultimate night, August refuses to open the Veil; Oscar promises to find another way. Emotional beat: defiant hope.

chapters.title: Every Name in the Book
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. Oscar realizes the engine reads names, not voices — anyone who speaks the First Tongue can key it. Emotional beat: terrible clarity.

chapters.title: Learning to Say It
chapters.summary: August's POV. August teaches Oscar the full phrase that opens the Veil, knowing what it will cost them both. Emotional beat: intimacy as inheritance.

chapters.title: The Night of Thirteen Moons
chapters.summary: Multiple POV. The thirteenth moon rises; Veyren initiates the opening with August bound before the orrery. Emotional beat: dread at full pitch.

chapters.title: The Scribe Speaks
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. Oscar breaks free and speaks the First Tongue aloud, seizing the engine's key. Emotional beat: a lifetime of silence broken in one sentence.

chapters.title: Two Doors, One Choice
chapters.summary: Oscar and August's POV. The Veil stands half-open; Oscar can seal it with a lie or remake it with truth. Veyren pleads, Ilara aims, Sefa bleeds. Emotional beat: the choice distilled.

chapters.title: The Unbinding
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. Oscar speaks the true binding — neither wall nor gate, but a treaty written in living language — and the Veil becomes a border with doors. Emotional beat: catharsis.

chapters.title: What It Cost
chapters.summary: Ilara's POV. Veyren falls into the closing threshold; Ilara chooses not to save him, and must live with that. Emotional beat: grief without regret.

chapters.title: Erased
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. The treaty consumes Oscar's name from every ledger — debt, records, even memory of their surname. Emotional beat: liberation and loss in the same breath.

chapters.title: The Border Town
chapters.summary: August's POV. Months later, August lives among returned First Speakers, teaching children both tongues. Emotional beat: belonging finally earned.

chapters.title: A Door Left Open
chapters.summary: Ilara and Oscar's POV. Ilara finds Oscar working as an unnamed translator at the new border house; something like forgiveness, maybe more, begins again. Emotional beat: cautious warmth.

chapters.title: First Entry, New Book
chapters.summary: Oscar's POV. Oscar opens a blank ledger and writes the first line of the treaty in the First Tongue — signed with no name at all. Emotional beat: peace as an ongoing act, not an ending.
